scene_description: Narrow wooden shelf with a wooden back and left side panel. A blue patterned pouch stands on the left, a black round container sits near the front in the middle, and a white deodorant stands beside a silver-lidded jar on the right.

targets.name: blue pouch
targets.description: Blue patterned fabric pouch with a red zipper and white Kiehl's lettering, standing at the left end of the shelf beside the black round container.
nearby_obstacles: Wooden back panel behind the pouch
Wooden side panel to the left
targets.clearance_notes: The front, top, and right side are exposed. The nearby wooden panels limit rear and left approaches, but access from the front remains open.
targets.other_notes: The fabric pouch can deform when handled.

targets.name: black round container
targets.description: Low round container with a black lid labeled GATSBY, near the front edge of the shelf between the blue pouch and white deodorant.
targets.orientation: lying flat with lid facing upward
targets.clearance_notes: The lid and front edge are exposed, with space around the container and no object resting on top.

targets.name: white deodorant
targets.description: Tall white oval deodorant container with teal NATIVE lettering, standing to the right of the black round container and to the left of the silver-lidded jar.
nearby_obstacles: Silver-lidded jar close to the right
targets.clearance_notes: The top and front are exposed. The adjacent jar reduces clearance on the right, but the deodorant is not covered and a front approach remains open.

targets.name: silver-lidded jar
targets.description: Short pale jar with a reflective silver lid and OLAY lettering, standing to the right of the white deodorant.
nearby_obstacles: White deodorant close to the left
targets.clearance_notes: The lid, front, and right side are exposed. The deodorant limits clearance on the left, but does not block access from the front.
